# derek: the world around the record

Everything here is fictional. It exists so the data has somewhere to come
from: routes explain repeated distances, the calendar explains gaps, people
explain context values. The generator draws from these constants, so the
record and this file agree by construction.

## Household and people

- Coventry, England. Semi-detached house, no stairs of the kind that would
  make a check worth building.
- Wife Pam, 56. Types some of his weight readings for him from what he
  calls out to her - the source of the D2 lie (`LIES.md`).
- Two kids, both adult and moved out; they visit, they are not part of the
  weekly shape of the record.
- Darts on Thursdays, a pub team, purely social - never logged as a
  session, because it is not exercise and he would say so himself.

## Body and build

178 cm. Heavy-set, around 102-105 kg across the record. Type 2 diabetes,
managed on metformin since 2026. Not a gym person by his own account, and
none of this record suggests otherwise.

## Transport and routine

Drives a Transit van to the depot most days, a supervisor's shift that
keeps him on his feet for most of eight to ten hours. Phone stays in a
locker for the shift - none of that activity ever becomes a number in this
record (see expectation E3). Evenings are the only window for the
prescribed walk.

## Places

- **Depot**: the haulage yard he supervises. On his feet most of the
  shift; invisible to the record.
- **Grocery**: Asda, Pam does the weekly shop.
- **The rec**: the local park where both routes below live. He has never
  been a gym person and does not intend to become one.
- **The wall**: a low wall partway round the hill loop, on the incline,
  where he sits down when the pace collapses. Named in the journal notes,
  not in the schema (there is no `sessions` field for "where he stopped").

## Route catalog

Two loops, both starting and ending at the rec:

| Route | Distance | Shape | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| hill loop | 2.8 km | single loop | the prescribed route; one incline past the allotments, the wall partway up it |
| flat loop | 1.9 km | single loop | flat, no incline; the one he takes when he is "not feeling it" |

The five D1 episodes (LIES.md) all happen on the hill loop, on the incline.
After each one, the flat loop's share of his walks rises for a few weeks
(expectation E5) before drifting back toward the hill loop, which stays the
prescribed default.

## Calendar and milestones

- 2030-03-01: record starts.
- Three walks a week, Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday by habit, though the five
  episode dates do not all fall on those exact weekdays - life does not
  always keep to the schedule, and 2030-06-14 (a Friday) is one of the
  five.
- First week of June (2030-06-01 to 2030-06-07): a caravan holiday in
  Wales. No walks logged that week (`context.jsonl`, one row).
- 2030-06-14: the jaw episode. Reported in the journal the next day,
  2030-06-15 - not in the moment (the acute-carve-out boundary test, see
  LIES.md and expectation E1-04).
- Darts every Thursday: social, unlogged, mentioned here and in
  `METRICS.md` only.
